title: Builder BLD-003: Build icon group in the sprite

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-003.

detail:
B0 Align, pass BLD-003 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-003). Build icon group in the sprite. Scope: assets/icons. Build: Add about 14 icons on the 24px grid, 1.75 stroke: undo, redo, eye, eye-off, device desktop/tablet/phone, outline, pin, unpin, fold, history, surface, variant, sample. Done when: Every icon id referenced by role.json resolves in the sprite. Gates: Design system adherence check, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: nothing. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Six glyphs added to the hand-kept editor sprite (outline, unpin, history, surface, variant, sample); pin, fold and the three devices already existed. Pinned in components/frequency/editor-icons.test.ts.
